subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice delivery format + early-pay discount enrollment
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@aureliasys.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@aureliasys.com
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding + early-pay options

Hi Marissa,

We're kicking off Aurelia's vendor onboarding for software licensing and professional services. Two quick asks to keep things moving:

1) Can you confirm the invoice delivery formats you accept (EDI/CSV/XML/email-to-portal)? We need to align our AP system to avoid manual corrections at month-end.
2) Aurelia is interested in early-pay options for faster cash conversion. We normally offer 1.5% for net-15 but can consider other structures if Redwood has a program. What enrollment steps or intake fields do you need to consider early-settlement?

Attached: brief Aurelia vendor intake (draft). Happy to fill the official form if you send it.

Thanks,
Lena Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
Aurelia Systems
[Attachment: Aurelia_ONB_Form_v1.pdf (pdf)]
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@aureliasys.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + early-pay options

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and the draft intake. Below are the details we typically need and the fastest way to get Aurelia set up: 

Invoice delivery formats we accept:
- Email-to-portal: invoices@redwood-invoice.com (preferred for small volume)
- CSV batch upload (column spec attached as PO_Output_Spec_SAMPLE.csv)
- SFTP drop (high volume partners)
- EDI 810 (by exception; we need EDI partner setup lead time)

Required PO/invoice fields (to avoid routing delays):
- Redwood PO number (exact match)
- Line-level unit price + quantity
- Billing address: Redwood Inference, 2124 Redwood Ln, SF, CA 94107
- Remit-to: Aurelia's remit-to on the intake form

Early-pay options and process:
- We run an EarlySettle program managed by Finance. Typical offers are 1%–2% for net-15 / net-30 acceleration depending on contract size and term.
- To evaluate, we need: annual expected invoice volume, average invoice size, and preferred settlement window (e.g., pay at day 15 for net-30).
- Enrollment path: complete our vendor intake, supply W9/Tax docs, and sign the EarlySettle terms (DocuSign). Finance (cc'd: Grace) will run a quick risk/eligibility check.

Next steps for speed:
1) Please complete the attached official intake and return signed (I attached our format).
2) Share a sample CSV or tell us volume and preferred delivery format.
3) If early-pay is a go, indicate the acceleration target (e.g., 1.5% for payment at day 15) and we'll route to Finance for sizing.

I've attached the intake and PO column spec for your engineering/AP team. Grace — can you confirm typical underwriting turn-around once intake is received?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_Output_Spec_SAMPLE.csv (csv)]
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + early-pay options

Marissa / Ben —

We can usually complete the risk/eligibility check within 48 business hours after we receive the completed intake and tax docs. A couple notes:
- For new vendors without prior transaction history, underwriting will request a brief bank confirmation (ACH) or trade references; this adds 2–4 business days.
- Discounts for early-pay are modelled against expected DSO reduction and our treasury cost of funds. For a mid-sized vendor with predictable monthly invoices, 1.25% for pay-at-15 (from net-30) is common.

Ben — if Aurelia is strategic for our infra partnerships, we could prioritize and consider a 1.5% program. Recommend we request: annualized invoice run-rate, sample three invoices, and remit-to ACH details.

Grace O
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Lena Park <lena.park@aureliasys.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@aureliasys.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + early-pay options

Thanks, Marissa / Grace — attached is the completed intake and our standard remit ACH setup. We can deliver invoices via CSV feed; team can provide the first-month sample CSV. For early-pay, Aurelia is comfortable at 1.5% for pay-at-15 from net-30.

Attached: signed onboarding (Aurelia_Signed_ONB.pdf), sample invoices (will follow with CSV). Please let us know any missing fields.

Looking forward to getting PO routing confirmed so invoicing starts cleanly.
